units.title: Complete authentic Slice 1 technical delivery and reach A1
units.objective: Execute the already-frozen Slice 1 contract against the exact data-contracts consumer, retain the revision-scoped context artifacts, and stop at the human A1 utility checkpoint without performing post-A1 gap closure or next-slice derivation.

included: Reconcile only compatible PR #4 verification salvage into PR #5
Run Enforced Planning governed-repo install and strict audit
Run focused repository-context tests against the exact pinned consumer
Generate and retain revision-scoped context.json and index.html
Present the generated HTML for Attention Checkpoint A1
excluded: Generalized indexing, graph, orchestration, or dashboard infrastructure

outputs: Revision-scoped RepositoryContextArtifact JSON for the pinned consumer
Static source-bound HTML working surface for the pinned consumer

acceptance.criterion: The frozen Slice 1 technical checks execute authentically against the exact pinned external consumer and retain explicit unknown/error semantics.
evidence_required: Focused pytest result with AES_DATA_CONTRACTS_CHECKOUT bound to the exact consumer revision
Successful CLI generation at the exact expected consumer revision
acceptance.negative_control: CI pre-step failure, a synthetic-only fixture, or plan completion alone cannot be promoted to successful external verification.

acceptance.criterion: The generated HTML is handed to the user for direct utility judgment before post-A1 characterization or gap recomputation begins.
evidence_required: User A1 disposition: continue | change | stop
acceptance.negative_control: Automated green cannot substitute for the user utility observation.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One live claim owns the single active PR #5 Slice 1 line until the generated A1 surface is handed to the user.
